description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order under Section 22 of the Foreign Exchange No. 12 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves regulatory matters under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017. It contains an order issued by the Minister of Finance that imposes limits and suspensions on various foreign exchange transactions, including repatriation of funds, outward remittances, and investment activities. The content focuses on establishing legal/regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
